purpose: Ten alternative application icon concepts for review

concepts.name: 刘海水滴
concepts.idea: 把刘海与可拖动水滴合成一个标记，最直接对应应用独有交互。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original macOS application icon concept for Herdr Island.
Product context: a quiet native macOS utility that gathers multiple coding agents beside the screen notch; a liquid droplet can be dragged away to create a task or tether a window. Brand traits: precise, calm, fluid, useful, beautifully native.
Output: exactly ONE standalone icon, square canvas, front-on orthographic view, centered macOS rounded-square tile occupying about 88% of the canvas, with a genuinely transparent exterior outside the tile. The tile itself is opaque. A bold, memorable central symbol must read at 32px. Generous internal breathing room. Professional finished icon artwork, clean controlled edges.
Constraints: no presentation board, no labels, no words, no numbers, no watermark, no computer or phone mockup, no extra objects, no third-party logos, no generic AI sparkles or brain motifs. Keep surface treatment restrained and symbol geometry strong.
Primary request: the signature notch-and-droplet emblem. Inside a deep graphite rounded-square tile, show a wide short satin-silver bar with a flat upper edge and generous rounded lower corners, floating in the upper middle. From the exact center of its lower edge hangs one luminous ice-blue droplet, joined by a very short thin liquid neck. The droplet is the visual protagonist, broad and substantial, rounded lower body, subtle dimensional glasslike shading and one restrained highlight. The notch bar and droplet together form a compact unmistakable silhouette. No status dots, no other symbols. Palette: graphite #141820, frost silver, ice blue #5B9DFF. Quiet soft top-left light, exquisitely clean macOS app icon.

Primary request: a bespoke liquid H monogram. A single thick sculpted capital H, made of two short vertical rounded silver-blue pillars connected across their middle by a fluid pinched bridge. The lower end of the right pillar curves into a subtle droplet bulb; the overall letter must be clear and geometrically confident, not a cursive word. Primary request: an agent coordination orbit emblem. A single substantial cobalt-blue circular hub at center, surrounded by one broad elliptical orbital arc with three rounded satellite nodes, clearly separated and balanced at three positions around the orbit. Satellites are muted ice blue, mint, and warm amber to echo running, completed, attention states. No fine network lines: use a bold simple orbit band and clear masses. Deep navy graphite tile, refined softly extruded material, low relief rather than an elaborate 3D scene. Three satellites only, one core only. Calm precise composition, no starfield, no outer-space illustration.

Primary request: an abstract archipelago emblem. Three smooth rounded pebble-islands grouped into a compact asymmetric triangle; one larger foreground island and two smaller upper islands. Each island is a very simple softly extruded flattened rounded shape seen from a shallow overhead angle, with clean edges. Muted sea-glass teal and sage islands on a pale porcelain rounded-square tile, subtle blue-grey shadows. A narrow blue negative-space water channel separates the three islands. Primary request: a developer terminal droplet emblem. One large flat-bottomed, softly rounded ice-mint teardrop stands upright at the center of an almost-black graphite tile. Inside the droplet, a thick dark terminal chevron and short underscore form the simple >_ prompt, beautifully optically aligned, with ample spacing and only these two marks. Green-mint #3DDD97 with pale cyan edge, calm premium native macOS styling. Only the terminal >_ symbol, no other text.

A short curved blue stem flows smoothly from the frame's bottom-right corner toward a single substantial detached-looking blue droplet below the window; the stem ends just before the droplet with a small clear gap. Primary request: a drop-and-ripple launch emblem. A large bold sapphire-blue water droplet floats immediately above a single broad elliptical silver-blue ripple ring. The drop tip points upward, its rounded bottom nearly touching the center of the ripple. The ellipse is clean, thick and strongly foreshortened, with a dark empty center. Composition is compact and centered on a dark navy tile. Restrained luminous material with clear form, soft top-left highlight. Exactly one droplet and one ripple ring; no extra concentric rings, no splashes, no realistic water scene. Polished dimensional native app icon, simple enough at small scale.

Primary request: a coordinated flock emblem. Three identical thick rounded arrowhead shapes, like soft folded paper wedges rather than literal birds, point diagonally upward-right in a compact coordinated formation. The largest cobalt blue wedge leads, two smaller mint and pale-blue wedges follow with even clear gaps. Strong simple silhouette, no tails, no eyes, no ornamental lines. Do not resemble a play-button stack; make the wedges elongated directional forms with softly rounded ends.

Primary request: a radically minimal negative-space island mark. On a solid very pale ice-blue rounded-square tile, place one bold near-black softly rounded horizontal island capsule occupying roughly 60% of the tile width and 35% of its height. A large clean droplet-shaped negative-space cutout opens from the exact middle of the capsule's bottom edge and rises into its body, like a teardrop inlet: the cutout is the same pale blue as the tile and must remain open to the outside below. The capsule and its negative-space droplet should feel like one memorable custom emblem. Perfectly flat 2D, no gradients, no highlights, no shadows, no decorative elements. Strict two-color silhouette, exquisite optical balance, strong enough for a monochrome menu-bar identity.
